name: WhatSThis_15
short_caption: The robot pulls its hands inward near its chest and then sweeps them outward to the sides with palms up to show or present something.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing pose and pulls both hands up and inward toward its chest, with wrists slightly bent. It then extends both arms outward and downward to its sides, presenting its open palms facing upward. Finally, the arms smoothly return down to the neutral resting position at its sides.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps both arms outward to the sides; ensure lateral clearance is clear of objects or visitors.
